title: Regenerate the managed Quest block for Quest CLI 0.12.0
description: OPAG-967, dispatched by opum-agent: move this repository from the 0.11.0 lore/quest pair to the published 0.12.0 pair. The federated pins already moved to v0.12.0 in OMARK-78; what remains is the third place the quest version lives, the managed Quest block in CLAUDE.md, from which CI derives the quest version it installs. npm latest is 0.12.0 on both packages and the workstation CLIs are 0.12.0; quest agents --check reports version-only drift (block records 0.11.0, content otherwise current). No literal quest or lore pin remains in CI: both installs derive from repository state, so the only live 0.11.0 is the block itself. Scope: regenerate the block, run the gates, land via branch and PR, then promote.

acceptanceCriteria.text: CLAUDE.md managed Quest block declares Quest CLI 0.12.0 after a regeneration whose diff is confined to generated bytes between the managed markers.
quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude and lore agents --check both exit 0 with no remaining drift.
Local gates pass: lore check and the five test suites exit 0.
The PR into dev carrying the change has the three required contexts (check · manifests, Tracker integrity, lore check) green on its head SHA.

finalSummary: Regenerated the managed Quest block in CLAUDE.md to declare Quest CLI 0.12.0 (OPAG-967) - the last live 0.11.0 in the repository after OMARK-78 moved both federated pins to v0.12.0. Regenerated with quest agents --update-instructions --target claude; the diff is one line strictly inside the quest:agent-instructions markers (begin 45, end 53), asserted structurally, so the routine managed-block carve-out covers it. No literal lore or quest pin remained in CI - both install steps derive their versions from repository state - so no other bump was owed (grepped, not assumed). Verified: npm latest 0.12.0 on both packages and both workstation CLIs; quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude went from version-only drift to state current, exit 0; lore agents --check, lore check and the five suites all exit 0; CI on the PR head 1c901ea resolved Declared Quest version: 0.12.0 and ran green with all three required contexts satisfied, and its Tracker integrity log carries read 81 task record(s).
